_comment: Sites kept off the page even though DOC approves them. DOC updates its whitelist slowly, so a site students should not reach can stay on it for months. Each key is a host, matched with any scheme, 'www.', path or subdomain: 'quizlet.com' also catches 'www.quizlet.com/join' and 'help.quizlet.com'. Listing a subdomain excludes only that subdomain. A key with a path ('example.com/staff') excludes that path and everything under it. The value is the reason, shown in the build output.

exclude.quizlet.com: Students should not have access. Excluded by Corrections Education 2026-10-06.
exclude.dl.correctionsed.com: Students should not have access. Excluded by Corrections Education 2026-10-06.
